annotations.title: Verify a company in official registers (paid)

description: Use when you need to verify that a company exists and is active: official registers GLEIF (worldwide, incl. Dutch LEI holders), UK Companies House, Ireland CRO, Estonia, Belgium KBO, France SIRENE, Norway, Finland, Czechia, Slovakia and Poland (with bank accounts). Returns legal name, status, registry id, legal form, address, founding date and parent companies (GLEIF). Search by name or id. Costs 0.008 USDC via x402, or 4 credits of a Factline API key.

country.description: ISO country, e.g. GB, IE, EE, FR, NO, NL

id.description: LEI, SIREN, Norwegian organisation number, UK company number, Irish CRO number or Estonian registry code

name: company_lookup
